invariants: Clusters and theories remain proposals until validated.
Specialized children and source distinctions are preserved.
Elegant abstraction never outranks failed evidence.
procedure: Extract the smallest useful shared mechanism and variant dimensions.
Propose an abstraction only when it measurably reduces duplication.
Test on held-out domains, counterexamples, and competing taxonomies.

confidence: may adjust only through declared evidence and method
knowledge: may add or revise typed records only with provenance
memory: no persistent memory write unless explicitly contracted and scope-bound
registry: may propose changes; canonical mutation requires admission and evidence
runtime: bounded by target orchestration, permissions, containment, and rollback

summary: Propose higher-order capabilities that reduce duplication while retaining specialized child adapters, constraints, tests, and callable identities.
title: Meta-Capability Proposer
when_to_use: Use after stable shared mechanisms recur across domains or projects.
